ATTRIBUTION_GAP: The (5.13) shape is BaseResidual.PolynomialEdgeJets, NavierStokes/BaseResidual.lean:1640, with delta = ActiveAnnulusWeight.edgeDistance, NavierStokes/ActiveAnnulusWeight.lean:25, which is min 1 (min (y-a) (b-y)) verbatim. For n = 1 it is obtained by feeding EntranceAlignedBase.modulated_first_edgeJets (:876, collar), modulated_positive_stress_zero (:833), modulated_smooth (:826) and zeroEnd_lt_outer_collar (:709) into BaseResidual.edgeJets_of_outer_collar (:2687). For n >= 2 the N = 0 form follows from modulated_higherInteriorSupport (:838) with BaseResidual.compact_weighted_jet_bound (:2666) or SlowStressSupport.logarithmic_weighted_jets (NavierStokes/SlowStressSupport.lean:1130). What is exported instead is the summed ConstructedSlowBase.WeightedStressBound (:438) via weighted_on_actual_scales (:446).

Every clause of Lemma 5.2 is stated somewhere for the final globalized profiles - the equations (5.2) and (5.5), the moment vanishing, the support of all five components of P_n including F_n/X, smoothness at the axis and across X >= 0, inner agreement on an interval larger than [0, X_-], both stress supports, and the ingredients of (5.13) - except one: that the extension retains Lemma 5.1's eta-parameter regularity on [0, a^2]. No declaration states that clause; the globalization is carried out in the real-smooth EvenProfile category. An earlier version of this ruling held that recovering it needs analytic facts the repository does not state. A deeper trace shows that is false. (1) On [0, cutoffInner), which contains [0, X_-], all four components equal the inner AxisFunction profile (GlobalSlowProfiles.profiles_inner_eq, :1814), which is holomorphic in eta on an open U containing [-1,1] (SlowRecursion.lean:71; AssembledSlowBase.lean:1039, :1058): instantiation. (2) Left of the bump patch, U_n and phi_n equal the seed (:928, :932), and the seed is by definition an eta-independent cutoff times the real trace of the inner coefficient (:1117-1118, :350, :151): unfolding plus multiplication by a constant, which is the paper's own argument on p. 51. (3) V_n/X and F_n/X are parameter integrals of U_n and its eta-derivative (:1062, :217, :185), and holomorphy of such integrals, of radial derivatives and of products with a radial factor is stated for arbitrary families (ActivationHolomorphic.lean:193, :240, :260, :936, :136, :112; BoundaryAxisJets.lean:422, :528): a short combination. (4) Pi_n is the integral of a source built from phi, u, beta of orders <= n, including order 0 and never a lower pressure (:1066, :287, :267), so no induction on n is needed; each operator in the source has a stated holomorphy-preserving counterpart (SlowRecursion.lean:196, :219, :549, :561), and order-zero agreement with the hierarchy on [cutoffInner, windowCap) is obtained by repeating the bodies of EntranceAlignedBase.base_phi_axial_pressure (:200) and base_beta_pos (:224), which use the bound X < cutoffInner only through X <= lo, X <= analyticEnd and X < nominalRadius^2. Step (4) is a long assembly written nowhere in the repository. I read the statements and the proofs cited and compiled nothing. Taking a^2 to be any point in (cutoffStop, windowCap] gives X_- < X_keep < X_cut < a^2 < inf I_pos as on p. 50. Since no unstated analytic fact or object is needed, the clause follows from stated declarations by combination and the item is SINGLE_SOURCE_OK with relation different_formulation: the Lean builds every inner order first, from inner coefficients only (SlowRecursion.lean:918, :931, :1272), and cuts off afterwards, so it never uses the clause, whereas the paper interleaves Lemma 5.1 and Lemma 5.2 and consumes the clause at the next order (p. 47). The remaining finding on this clause is low: an unstated clause that costs nothing downstream and is closed by stated declarations. The first audit's verdict was right in the end, though not for the reason it gave (it conceded the clause without showing it recoverable); the first audit's citations on the F_n/X support, firstStress_edgeJets and the sharp n >= 2 support stand.

findings.summary: No declaration states that a globalized order-n profile is holomorphic in eta; the Lean states (a) that all four components equal the holomorphic inner hierarchy on [0, cutoffInner), an interval longer than [0, X_-], and (b) that U_n and phi_n equal the eta-independent cutoff times the inner coefficient everywhere left of the bump patch. The rest of the clause (V_n/X, F_n/X and Pi_n on the cutoff transition, with radial derivatives) follows from these and the repository's general lemmas on holomorphy of products, radial derivatives and parameter integrals, with no unstated analytic fact; that derivation is short for V_n/X and F_n/X, long and unwritten for Pi_n, and I read it without compiling.

No single declaration states Lemma 5.2. Its clauses are spread over GlobalSlowProfiles, AssembledSlowBase and EntranceAlignedBase, and the induction is encoded as well-founded recursion over a Scheme whose radii are fixed once.

The per-order jet bound (5.13) for the final modulated coefficients is not exported as a declaration; the repository exports the summed bound plus the collar and interior ingredients, from which (5.13) follows by instantiating stated theorems.
